newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen moving with mixed trend.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen moving with mixed trend.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to be mixed after a brief rally ahead of the weekend, brokers said. Friday and Saturday mark the weekend in Bangladesh.
"The market is most likely to be mixed. A number of blue-chip shares in engineering and cement sectors may fall on profit taking," said broker Shakil Rizvi.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index rose 5.21 points or 0.55 percent at 949.78 on a turnover of 36.4 million taka on Wednesday. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
